name: remote-agents
description: Remote control for Cursor, Codex, and Claude Code agents with a mobile-first HTTPS dashboard.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @remote-agents/shared && npm run build -w @remote-agents/web && npm run build -w @remote-agents/server && npm run build -w @remote-agents/worker
scripts.test: npm run test -w @remote-agents/shared && npm run test -w @remote-agents/server && npm run test -w @remote-agents/worker && npm run test -w @remote-agents/web && node --test scripts/gen-secrets.test.cjs scripts/server-worker.integration.test.cjs scripts/worker-installer.test.cjs scripts/installer-systemd.test.cjs scripts/rollback-server.test.cjs
